# Moose Supply

Moose Supply is the physical merchandise store for Moose, a local workspace for coding agents.

Canonical URL: https://moose-merch.shqingda.workers.dev/
Contact: shqingda@gmail.com

## What the store sells

- Moose heavyweight cotton T-shirt: CNY 179
- Moose ceramic mug: CNY 89
- Moose desk mat: CNY 139
- Moose enamel pin: CNY 59
- Moose waterproof sticker pack: CNY 39

## Fulfillment

- Orders ship from China.
- In-stock goods usually dispatch within 3 to 5 business days.
- Shipping is available to mainland China and selected international destinations.
- Shipping cost depends on the delivery address.

## Returns and support

- Return requests are accepted within 7 days of delivery for unused and unwashed goods in original packaging; custom goods are excluded.
- Damaged, incorrect, or missing orders should be reported with photos within 48 hours of delivery.
- Support email: shqingda@gmail.com

## About Moose

Project: https://github.com/shqingda/moose
